 Floodwaters in Fort Lauderdale start to recede but danger persists
 Flooding was also reported in Fort Lauderdale on Wednesday morning due to the heavy rain, but water is beginning to recede. That has officials warning drivers to avoid water-covered roadways and to allow for extra time if travel is needed. CBS News Miami’s Larry Seward has the latest along Davie Boulevard.
